title: A History of Albion
intro: Albion remembers its kings, but the isles remember what came before them.

eras.name: the Old Halls
eras.summary: Before Camelot, the keepers' halls under the hills.
eras.text: Before any king, the isles kept their halls under the hills and their words in an older tongue.

events.name: The keepers' bargain
events.text: When the ogres came, the keepers of Krondon made their bargains.

eras.name: the War of the Isles
eras.text: Morgana's war broke on Avalon, and the old halls fell one by one.

factions.name: the Keepers of Krondon
factions.summary: The old masters of weather and law.
factions.text: They counted wealth in weather, not gold.
